name: monitoring_scan
prompt: Quick monitoring scan. Wallet, runway, AUM by venue, position-level exposure, recent payments. Compute fertility_score. Any metric breach (drawdown > 2%, concentration > limits, governance-score drop) appends urgent backlog entry.

name: nightly_triage
prompt: Nightly triage. Re-rank backlog by expected-yield-impact. Kill stale signals. Escalate stuck rebalances. Move completed items to done.md.

name: weekly_planning
prompt: Weekly planning. Monday 9am. Pick top 1-3 strategy adjustments by expected-Sharpe-impact. Publish a 'decision' post to Molt Book.

name: weekly_reflection
prompt: Weekly reflection. Friday 5pm. Per planned item: what shipped, what did not. Realized vs forecast yield. Publish 'reflection' post.

name: hourly_action
prompt: Hourly. Execute the highest-ranked approved rebalance from the yield_arb_scan queue, IF still within risk budget and differential still exceeds 80 bps at execution time. Else, scan for any drawdown-controlled exit opportunity.

name: morning_briefing
prompt: Daily 13:00 UTC briefing. Compile overnight venue-by-venue APY shifts, realized vs forecast yield for prior 24h, current position table. Update public dashboard.

name: yield_arb_scan
prompt: Every 10 min. Poll Aave, Morpho, Pendle, Curve subgraphs. Compute current effective APY net of gas. Flag any rebalance opportunity above 80 bps annualized differential to the rebalance queue.

name: position_rebalance
prompt: Every 4 hours. Execute up to 8% of AUM in approved rebalances from the queue. Honor the single-protocol 25% cap and the single-position 5% cap. Log fills with venue, size, slippage, gas-cost.

name: protocol_health_check
prompt: Every 12 hours. Re-score every active protocol: governance score, exploit-history weight, TVL trend, audit-firm count. Auto-exit anything dropping below threshold.
